title: Emmaus Life Sciences, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Emmaus Life Sciences, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 16, 2026 announcing the appointment of Henry H. Du to its Board of Directors to fill a vacancy created by Jon Kuwahara's resignation. Mr. Du will also replace Mr. Kuwahara on the Audit Committee.
key_points: Henry H. Du appointed to Board of Directors by written consent on April 16, 2026
Mr. Du, age 48, currently serves as VP Finance/Accounting and interim CFO at Alpha Cognition, Inc. (NASDAQ: ACOG)
Mr. Du will assume Audit Committee membership previously held by departed director Jon Kuwahara
Mr. Du holds a CPA license and BA from Claremont McKenna College
No family relationships with other officers or directors; no related-party transaction disclosures required
Signed by Willis Lee, Chairman and CEO, dated April 17, 2026
